production.note: US model years 2003-2005. First: Mitsubishi's 4 March 2003 release 'Mitsubishi Motors Announces Pricing on 2003 Lancer Evolution'. Last: Mitsubishi's 22 July 2004 'What's New for 2005' release lists 'Lancer Evolution RS, Lancer Evolution VIII, and Lancer Evolution MR Edition' for 2005 (mitsubishi-us-2005-evo-whats-new); the Evolution IX followed as a 2006 model (separate record).

displacementL.note: Mitsubishi's US releases give '2.0-liter' only; no cc figure for this car was found on an opened Mitsubishi page.

fuel.note: Inferred from the turbocharged petrol 4G63 described on the cited page.

transmission.note: 5-speed manual on the standard car and RS; for 2005 the MR Edition had an exclusive '6-speed M/T close-ratio sport transmission'. For 2004 the 'five-speed manual is the only transmission available' (mitsubishi-us-2004-evo-rs). No automatic.

powerHp.note: Quote: "The Lancer Evolution and Lancer Evolution RS showcase a 2.0-liter 24-valve four-cylinder engine that produces 271 horsepower at 6500 rpm, 273 pound-feet of torque at 3500 rpm, and a power band that starts building just above idle." ('24-valve' is the release's error; the 2005 release says 16-valve.) Same rating at launch: "271 horsepower @ 6,500 rpm and 273 lbs.-ft of torque at 3,500 rpm" (mitsubishi-us-2003-evo-pricing). For 2005 Mitsubishi rated it 276 hp / 286 lb-ft ('+5 hp increase / +13 lb-ft increase', mitsubishi-us-2005-evo-whats-new); 271 hp covers two of the three model years, so it is used.

weightLb.note: Standard Lancer Evolution (not the RS), 5-speed manual, 2004 model. Quote: "When the difference between winning and losing can be measured in tenths of a second, the difference between the 3,321-lb Lancer Evolution and the 3,175-lb Lancer Evolution RS becomes significant." The sentence does not say 'curb weight'. No Mitsubishi weight for the 2003 model was found, so the reference year is 2004 (same 271 hp rating).

discrepancies.reason: Model year: 271 hp for 2003-2004, 276 hp for 2005 (larger turbo nozzle, new wastegate).
discrepancies.resolution: Used 271 hp: it covers two of three model years and the reference year is 2004.
